messages:
anika: kicking off A100 vs H100 skyline sweep across us-west / eu-west / ap-south for Mistral-7B and Llama-2-7B. comparing prefill vs decode latency, tokens/sec, and $/1M tokens with q4_0 and q8x4. feeding results here as I land them.

james: nice. what's the baseline config? batch size, seq len, quant backend?

anika: baseline: 1 request per GPU (iso qps), seq=1024 prefill+decode, batcher continuous mode, nvfuser kernels where available. quant backends: q4_0 and q8x4 via our quant pipeline. A100 = p4dn-ish SKUs, H100 = hpc-ish with newer cuda.

kai: any early numbers for tokens/sec decode? p50/p95/p99?

anika: quick summary: for Mistral-7B q4_0 decode tokens/sec (1k seq): H100 ~9.2k t/s, A100 ~7.5k t/s. p50 decode H100 8.3ms/token, A100 10.1ms/token. p99 tail: H100 42ms vs A100 52ms. prefill cost dominated but decode delta is meaningful.

james: price delta? give $/1M tokens at current cloud rates (exclude storage).

anika: $/1M tokens (prefill+decode, amortized over steady qps): q4_0: A100 ~$15.2, H100 ~$11.8. q8x4 tightens it: A100 ~$12.5, H100 ~$9.4. numbers include batching gains and KV cache hit assumptions of 15%.

perf-bot: uploaded results CSV to s3://redwood-sweeps/4105556789/summary.csv : https://s3.redwood.internal/4105556789/summary.csv

james: saw anything weird by region?

anika: eu-west A100 saw kernel fallthroughs for q8x4 when seq>1024. got nvfuser->generic fallback causing ~35% latency jump on decode p95. H100 in eu-west didn't hit that fallback.

kai: can we force kernel selection or hint for the batcher?

anika: yes — used kernel-hinting flag on canary to prefer the optimized kernel. forced kernel: 
```
batcher.kernel_hint: nvfuser
runtime.kernel_override: true
```
That recovered latency to within 5% of the H100 baseline for those tails.

ops-bot: canary rolled with kernel-hinting to 5% of traffic in eu-west; no rollback after 30m.

james: quality/regression checks for q8x4? any perplexity or weird tokenization artifacts?

anika: small perf delta on Mistral perplexity ~+0.02 on our eval set (negligible). Llama-2-7B showed tokenization jitter in code-heavy prompts with q8x4 — we see a handful of off-by-one token splits. flagged to model-evals for deeper diffs.

kai: for capacity sizing: tokens/sec vs price by region + recommended Dedicated pool size?

anika: quick table snippet (per GPU sustained decode t/s, q4_0 numbers):
```
region   | A100 t/s | H100 t/s | $/1M tok A100 | $/1M tok H100
us-west  |  7600    |  9300    |   $15.2       |   $11.8
eu-west  |  7200    |  9000    |   $16.0       |   $12.1
ap-south |  6800    |  8600    |   $17.5       |   $13.0
```
These assume 15% KV cache hit and steady multiplexing. For Dedicated pool sizing, recommend start with H100 pool sized for expected p95 throughput + 20% slack; e.g., target 800k tokens/sec sustained -> ~96 H100 GPUs (rough calc).

james: that H100 pool count looks high — can you drop back-of-envelope to show calc?

anika: rough: 800k t/s / 9.3k t/s per H100 ≈ 86 GPUs. +20% slack ≈ 103 -> round to 100 for procurement. For A100 you'd need ~106 -> round to 110.

kai: next actions?

anika: finish the full CSV upload, add model-eval diffs for Llama2 q8x4 artifacts, run 2nd sweep at seq=2048 to stress tail kernels, and prod a cost-run with 30% KV cache hit. I'll post updates here.

james: great. please cc infra when you flip kernel-hinting permanent.

anika: noted. tagging infra in next post.
